title: DocsLit configuration (docslit.json)
description: Configuration file for a DocsLit documentation project. Unknown top-level keys are allowed so newer CLI versions do not break older editors.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

name.description: Site name shown in the navigation bar, page titles, llms.txt and feeds.

description.description: Site description used for SEO meta tags, llms.txt and feeds.

url.description: Public base URL of the deployed site (for example https://docs.example.com). Used for the sitemap, canonical URLs, Open Graph images and llms.txt links.

basePath.description: URL sub-path the site is served from, for example "/repo" for GitHub Pages project sites. A leading slash is added and trailing slashes removed automatically.

editUrl.description: Base URL for "edit this page" links. Auto-detected from the git remote when omitted.

sidebar.description: Sidebar navigation. An array of groups, or the string "auto" to generate the whole sidebar from the docs/ folder.

oneOf.description: Generate the entire sidebar from the docs/ directory tree.

sidebars.description: Per-locale sidebars for i18n sites, keyed by locale code (for example "fr"). Locales without an entry use "sidebar".

links.description: Extra links rendered in the navbar.

items.description: Navbar entry. type: link (default), filled, outlined (buttons), github (repo link with client-side star count), discord, dropdown (with links).

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

rightIcon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

primary.description: Primary call-to-action button, right-most in the navbar.

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

links.description: Row of links in the footer bottom bar.

columns.description: Link columns above the bottom bar.

socials.description: Social links by platform name -> URL (github, x, discord, slack, linkedin, youtube, facebook, instagram, reddit, bluesky, mastodon, telegram, medium, hacker-news, website, rss …), rendered as icons.

head.description: Raw trusted HTML injected into <head> (a string, or an array of strings joined by newlines).

css.description: Path (relative to the project root) of a custom stylesheet copied to the build output and linked after the theme CSS.

favicon.description: Path to a favicon file in the project, or an http(s) URL. Defaults to the bundled DocsLit favicon.

logo.description: Logo: a path string, or { light, dark, href, text, height } for light/dark wordmarks (the site name is then not repeated beside it).

ogImage.description: Set to false to disable generated Open Graph images for every page. Pages can opt out individually with ogImage: false in frontmatter.

analytics.description: Analytics snippet preset injected into every page.

provider.description: Analytics provider. "google" is an alias of "ga4".

domain.description: Site domain (plausible; also accepted as the site id by fathom).

siteId.description: Provider site id (fathom site id; plausible domain fallback; ga4 measurement id fallback; posthog key fallback).

src.description: Override the provider script URL (plausible, fathom).

measurementId.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID, for example G-XXXXXXXXXX.

host.description: PostHog API host. Defaults to https://us.i.posthog.com.

theme.description: Pick a prebuilt look and palette: a theme name, a palette name, a path to a theme JSON file, or an inline theme object. THEME = layout, typography and shape; PALETTE = colours. Any theme works with any palette and custom colours. Run `docslit theme list`.

oneOf.description: Theme (default, peppermint, frond, tonal, folio, ledger), palette (teal, ocean, forest, slate, violet, rose, amber, graphite, mint, ink, paper, steel, iris) or path to a theme JSON file. A theme name uses that theme's signature palette; a palette name keeps the classic look.

name.description: Theme id (default, peppermint, frond, tonal, folio, ledger). Any other value is a brand display name used to derive "id".

palette.description: Colour palette (teal, ocean, forest, slate, violet, rose, amber, graphite, mint, ink, paper, steel, iris). Default: the theme's signature palette.

colors.description: Color tokens applied in both modes (accent, bg, text, border, ...). See `docslit theme list`.

dark.description: Color tokens applied only in dark mode.

light.description: Color tokens applied only in light mode.

fonts.description: Font stacks and shape overrides (sans, heading, mono, radius, radiusLg). Themes ship system-font fallbacks; custom fonts must be loaded by your own css.

radius.description: Corner radius scale: none, sm, md, lg, xl, full, or a length such as "6px". Overrides the theme's radii.

appearance.description: Default colour mode for first-time visitors. Readers can still toggle unless "strict" is true.

strict.description: Hide the light/dark toggle and always use "appearance".

theme.description: Explicit theme id (alternative to "name" when "name" is a brand label).

extends.description: Legacy: palette to start from (alias of "palette"). A theme id here selects that theme.

file.description: Path to a theme JSON file to merge in (see `docslit theme init`).

announcement.description: Site-wide dismissible banner shown above the navbar.

default.description: Version served at the site root.

branch.description: Git branch containing the docs for this version.

tag.description: Label shown in the version dropdown (Latest, Beta, LTS...).

announcement.description: Version-specific announcement; overrides the site-level one on that version.

i18n.description: Lightweight i18n: the default locale lives in docs/, other locales in docs.<locale>/.

locales.description: All locale codes, including the default.

labels.description: Display names for the locale switcher, keyed by locale code.

openapi.description: OpenAPI spec used for API reference pages, wc-endpoint ref resolution and the playground.

oneOf.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec file (YAML or JSON).

spec.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec file.

overlay.description: Path to an OpenAPI Overlay file applied on top of the spec.

proxyUrl.description: CORS proxy URL; requests go to <proxyUrl>?url=<target>.

pdf.description: PDF export (requires Playwright). Enable per build with --pdf.

enabled.description: Generate PDFs on every build without needing --pdf.

outputDir.description: Subdirectory of the build output for PDFs.

apiReference.description: Include api/* pages in chapter and manual PDFs.

ignore.description: Page ids excluded from chapter and manual PDFs.

id.description: Chapter id (used in the file name).

redirects.description: Site-level redirects: old path -> new path or absolute URL. Emitted as meta-refresh stubs plus _redirects and vercel.json entries.

attributes.description: Global variables available as {{NAME}} placeholders in every page. Page frontmatter attributes and <wc-var name value /> override them.

lint.description: Docs quality linter settings for `docslit lint`.

rules.description: Per-rule level or options. Set a rule to "off" to disable it, or { "level": "warning", "max": 4000 } to tune it.

math.description: Build-time LaTeX math (KaTeX). Enabled by default; set false to disable.

enabled.description: Turn math rendering on or off.

singleDollar.description: Also treat $...$ as inline math (off by default; $$...$$ always works).

feedback.description: Page feedback widget ("Was this page helpful?"). true enables it; an object customizes it. Pages can opt out with feedback: false in frontmatter.

url.description: http(s) endpoint that receives a JSON POST for each response.

cloud.description: DocsLit Cloud settings used by `docslit publish`.

project.description: Cloud project slug to publish to.

tabs.description: Top-level navigation tabs. Each tab has its own sidebar; the active tab follows the current page. When set, the top-level sidebar is derived from the tabs.

anchors.description: Global anchors: pinned links at the top of every sidebar.

layout.description: Site layout. Lengths are numbers (px) or CSS lengths like "44rem".

tabsPlacement.description: Tabs in the header row (default) or at the top of the sidebar.

tocDepth.description: Heading levels in the TOC (3 = h2 + h3).

showDescription.description: Show frontmatter description as a subtitle under the title.

contextual.description: Page action menu ("Copy page" dropdown). Array of built-ins (copy, view-markdown, chatgpt, claude, perplexity, mcp) and custom {title, href, description?, icon?} (href placeholders {url} {markdown_url} {title} {path}); the first is the primary button. false disables. Also accepted as {options:[...]}.

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

themePicker.description: Show a floating theme/palette/mode picker in the built site (for galleries and demos). Off by default; `docslit dev --theme-picker` enables it in development only.

icons.description: Icon settings. `library` chooses which icon set a bare icon name resolves in: auto (default; the built-in names keep the Lucide look, everything else tries Lucide then Font Awesome), lucide or fontawesome. Icons are inlined as SVG at build time.

library.description: Icon set used to resolve bare icon names.

^sidebar\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Per-locale sidebar written as a flat key, for example "sidebar.fr".

lintRule.description: A level ("off", "info", "warning", "error") or an object with a level and numeric thresholds (min / max).

href.description: Link target: site path (/guide/intro) or absolute URL.

external.description: Open in a new tab. Detected automatically for http(s) URLs.

dismissible.description: Allow readers to dismiss the banner.

sidebarGroup.description: A sidebar group (top-level) or nested subgroup. Provide explicit "pages", an "autogenerate" source, or both (explicit pages come first).

pages.description: Page ids (path under docs/ without extension), page objects, or nested subgroups.

autogenerate.description: Fill this group from a docs/ directory. Page order comes from frontmatter sidebar_position; subfolders become subgroups (label/position/collapsed via _category.json).

collapsed.description: true = collapsible, starts closed; false or "open-by-default" = collapsible, starts open. Unset = always open.

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

tag.description: Badge text shown next to the entry (for example "New").

availability.description: Availability badge: beta, alpha, preview, pre-release, in-development, new, deprecated (struck through), legacy. stable / generally-available show nothing.

hidden.description: Build the pages but keep the whole group out of the sidebar, search, llms.txt and sitemap.

expanded.description: Mintlify-style inverse of collapsed: true = collapsible and open.

root.description: Page id the group title links to (the page is listed first and not repeated in the group).

sidebarItem.description: A page id string, a page object, or a nested group.

anyOf.description: Page id: path under docs/ without extension, for example "guides/setup".

method.description: HTTP method badge (used by API pages).

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

tag.description: Badge text shown next to the entry (for example "New").

badge.description: Badge text shown next to the entry (for example "New").

availability.description: Availability badge: beta, alpha, preview, pre-release, in-development, new, deprecated (struck through), legacy. stable / generally-available show nothing.

hidden.description: Built and linkable, but not in the sidebar, search, llms.txt or sitemap (adds noindex).

anyOf.description: External/internal link entry in the sidebar.

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

tag.description: Badge text shown next to the entry (for example "New").

anchor.description: Pinned link at the top of the sidebar.

href.description: URL, or a page path such as /changelog.

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

tag.description: Badge text shown next to the entry (for example "New").

tab.description: A top-level navigation tab. Give it a sidebar (or a path to autogenerate from) or an href for an external link.

id.description: Stable id (default: slug of the label).

icon.description: Icon: a built-in/Lucide/Font Awesome name ("book-open", "fa-regular fa-rocket"), an image path or URL, or an emoji.

tag.description: Badge text shown next to the entry (for example "New").

sidebar.description: This tab's sidebar: groups (same shape as the top-level sidebar) or "auto" (autogenerate from path, or all of docs/).

path.description: docs/ folder owned by this tab: autogenerate source for sidebar "auto" and a fallback for choosing the tab of unlisted pages.

landing.description: Page id the tab opens (default: its first visible page).

href.description: External (or absolute) URL: the tab is a link and owns no pages.

hidden.description: Do not show in the tab bar (its pages still work).

openapi.description: This tab holds the generated OpenAPI sidebar.

anchors.description: Anchors shown only while this tab is active.
